meetings.summary: The East Maui Regional Board named its chair and vice chair to any East Maui irrigation system negotiations and adopted a motto.

meetings.body: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission approved an SMA exemption for Molokaʻi Community Health Center's renovations and heard an update on the Molokaʻi landfill.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Ethics
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Ethics
meetings.summary: The Board of Ethics voted on two requests for ethics advice and met in a closed-door session.

meetings.body: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: The commission put off a decision on Imua Family Services' preschool plan and approved plans for two homes rebuilt after the 2023 fire.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Adjudication Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Adjudication Board
meetings.summary: The liquor board fined two restaurants: $1,000 with $750 suspended, and $2,000 on each of two counts.

meetings.body: Maui County Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Commission approves minutes, hears evaluation, union and budget updates
meetings.summary: The commission approved its November 6, 2024 minutes and heard updates on the director's review, union contract talks and the budget.

meetings.body: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board reviewed 2025 nomination applicants in closed session and chose people to interview, including for the Housing Advisory Board.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meetings.summary: The Maui County Board of Ethics formed a group to review its gift guide and approved a press release on confidentiality.

meetings.body: MPO Policy Board
meetings.headline: MPO Policy Board
meetings.summary: The board approved a full 2045 transportation plan update with work extended to mid-April and agreed with state road classification reports.

meetings.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.summary: Fire officials reported over $890,000 in first FEMA checks, and the commission voted to support the fire department's budget in a letter to the mayor.

meetings.body: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness
meetings.headline: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness
meetings.summary: The commission heard recommendations on involving faith-based groups, elected its chair and vice chair, and learned a homeless strategic plan draft is due December 20.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Water Supply
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Water Supply
meetings.summary: The Board of Water Supply heard a West Maui groundwater briefing, put off a draft letter, reviewed capital projects, and approved its 2025 schedule.

meetings.body: Maui County Police Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Police Commission
meetings.summary: The commission heard a call to dismiss the police chief, voted on its budget letter, and set its next meeting for December 18.

meetings.body: East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meetings.headline: East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meetings.summary: Members voted on a fiscal year 2026 budget request to the mayor and passed a motion letting members testify for the board.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.summary: Roy's Limited Partnership No. 2 asked to allow drinking in set areas of its golf courses.

meetings.body: Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee Meeting
meetings.summary: The committee approved urban boundary and road classification updates and heard a proposal to extend the transportation plan update to March.

meetings.body: Maui County Police Commission Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Police Commission Meeting
meetings.summary: The Police Commission voted to send letters to the mayor about an investigator job and to the salary commission about the chief's pay.

meetings.body: Molokai Planning Commission Meeting
meetings.headline: Molokaʻi commission denies exemption for home demolition
meetings.summary: The commission denied an exemption for demolishing a two-story home after questions about landfill disposal and the site went unanswered.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission Meeting - South Maui Plan
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission Meeting - South Maui Plan
meetings.summary: The Maui Planning Commission heard testimony on the South Maui Community Plan, including the Promenade property, and took no action.

meetings.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.headline: Fire commission hears evacuation software plans and budget process briefing
meetings.summary: The commission heard about new evacuation software, approved its minutes, heard housing safety concerns, and learned how the fire budget works.

meetings.body: Upcountry Maui County Dept. of Water Supply Conservation Plan Meeting
meetings.headline: Upcountry residents weigh in on water conservation plan
meetings.summary: The Department of Water Supply presented a proposed Upcountry water conservation plan aiming for 20% savings by 2040, and residents asked about water meters.
